channel.title: LiveNow from Fox - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from LiveNow from Fox (livenowfox.com)

item.title: Popular cruise line abruptly changes 20 of its voyages, disrupting vacations
item.description: Royal Caribbean scrapped the itineraries for 20 upcoming voyages, impacting thousands of passengers.

item.title: Trader Joe's recalls over 9M pounds of vegetable fried rice sold in 43 states due to glass contamination
item.description: The new recall of Trader Joe's frozen vegetable fried rice products affects multiple states, including Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, and Georgia.

item.title: USDA issues alert for ground beef over possible metal contamination
item.description: The U.S. Department of Agriculture has issued a public health alert for certain grass-fed ground beef sold in several states due to possible metal contamination.

item.title: When it comes to morality, there’s one thing almost all Americans think is wrong, Pew poll finds
item.description: A new survey examining Americans’ moral qualms with a number of issues found one matter that nearly everyone could agree on: don’t cheat on your spouse.

item.title: Ford recalls more than 250,000 SUVs for software issues, NHTSA says
item.description: Ford’s new recall affects certain model Lincoln Navigator, Lincoln Nautilus, Lincoln Aviator and Ford Explorer SUVs manufactured between 2022 and 2025.

item.title: Iran war latest: 2nd US military aircraft downed in war with Iran
item.description: The war with Iran continues into its sixth week, likely to extend for at least two more weeks with the Strait of Hormuz remaining a major focal point to a ceasefire.

item.title: 2 US military planes downed in combat against Iran Friday: reports
item.description: A second U.S. military plane was reportedly shot down in combat against Iran Friday after an F-15E fighter jet crashed inside Iran, according to multiple reports.

item.title: What to know about the F-15E Strike Eagle aircraft
item.description: The U.S. Air Force says F-15E Strike Eagle aircraft are used in air-to-air and air-to-ground missions and its electronic systems allow the aircraft to fly day and night at low altitude, in all weather conditions.

item.title: US military SERE training - How service members are trained to survive
item.description: The United States military developed specialized training to prepare service members for extreme situations, including survival and evasion in hostile environments.

item.title: Garlic sold in three states recalled due to possible botulism contamination
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (USDA) says Tops Friendly Markets has issued a recall for peeled garlic due to possible botulism contamination.

item.title: Bed Bath & Beyond is attempting a comeback: What we know
item.description: Three years after filing for bankruptcy and closing all 360 stores, Bed, Bath & Beyond, one of the original big box retailers, is attempting a comeback.

item.title: Pope Leo celebrates first Good Friday with service, call to Israeli president
item.description: Pope Leo XIV celebrated his first Good Friday with a Celebration of the Passion of the Lord service at Peter’s Basilica in Vatican City.

item.title: Trump's budget calls for $1.5 trillion in military spending, cuts to everything else
item.description: President Trump’s budget would mark a 44% increase in Pentagon spending, while cutting what the administration calls “woke programs."

item.title: American Airlines customers say flights turned into bus trips without warning
item.description: Some American Airlines customers have arrived at smaller airports and gone through security only to find they were boarding a bus instead of a plane.

item.title: Retirement 'magic number' jumps as Americans grow anxious about their financial futures
item.description: Roughly 46% of Americans say they don't expect to be financially prepared when they stop working, a study found.
